chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Sue as a singer; his band's short stay at the new Apex
summary: Howard praises his wife's singing, and learns from the paper that his band played the new Apex for two to four weeks.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: No. Now, you take my wife there. Now, she was a very fine singer.
Sue was a very fine singer, eh?
Yeah, very good singer. She got these things all -- I see her bringing her papers in here, but they're authentic.
Oh, I bet she was, yes.
She was a good singer. She was a very good singer.
She said that shortly after the new Apex was opened that Paul's band came in.
After the new Apex opened, shortly after, you came in with your band at the new Apex, which was at what location?
55th, oh, yeah, I forgot about playing down there.
Got your band in there. See, that's what the paper helped and that's where Sue —
Uh-huh. I forgot I took my band in there.
Did you stay a long time, do you
Not too long. You know yourself.
You mean, it lasted a couple of weeks or something?
Yeah, two weeks or three, maybe four at the most.
